exceptions.reason: Not a hyphen defect. Vision-verified 2026-08-02 against Let's Play Doctor p85: the page is a TABLE whose headers read 'Nutrient | RDA | True Supplement Need | 30-Day Pharmacologic Daily Dose'. The OCR read ACROSS columns, splicing 'Pharma-' (from 'Pharmacologic', broken inside its own column) onto 'Need' from the neighbouring column. Rejoining would produce 'PharmaNeed', which appears nowhere. Needs a table-structure correction, tracked in chronicle/frontface-ocr/vision-held-hyphens.md.
